name: Cystatin C
rangeNote: No default range: reference values depend on the assay, age and sex, and children differ from adults. Cystatin C is less affected by muscle mass and diet than creatinine, so it can help when creatinine may mislead (for example with a lot or very little muscle). It can also be raised by inflammation, obesity, smoking, thyroid disease and corticosteroids, independent of kidney function. Used with creatinine to give a combined eGFR estimate.
summary: Cystatin C is a small protein made by almost all cells at a steady rate and cleared by the kidneys. Its blood level rises when the kidneys filter less, so it is used to estimate kidney filtration (eGFR), alone or together with creatinine.

high.meaning: A high cystatin C usually means the kidneys are filtering less than usual. In large studies, a cystatin C-based eGFR was linked to risk of death, cardiovascular death and kidney failure, and it classified more people as having reduced kidney function than a creatinine-based eGFR.

low.meaning: A low cystatin C is usually normal and reflects good kidney filtration.
commonCauses: Some medicines that lower its production
